crossRefs.note: My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
crossRefs.keyword: flee unto thee. Heb. hide me with thee

crossRefs.note: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.
crossRefs.keyword: flee unto thee. Heb. hide me with thee

crossRefs.note: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.
crossRefs.keyword: flee unto thee. Heb. hide me with thee

crossRefs.note: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings.
crossRefs.keyword: flee unto thee. Heb. hide me with thee

crossRefs.note: I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
crossRefs.keyword: flee unto thee. Heb. hide me with thee

crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
crossRefs.keyword: flee unto thee. Heb. hide me with thee

translations.web: Deliver me, Yahweh, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.
translations.bsb: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD; I flee to You for refuge.
translations.kjv: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide
translations.asv: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
